verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) or any managed Kubernetes offering, upgrade policy, or cluster autoscaling; it only covers CLI, SDKs, Terraform, IAM, billing, and free tier. The axis clearly applies to a major cloud platform, but no supporting evidence is present, and one community note even suggests OCI capacity/autoscaling limitations generally. missing for 10: any documentation of OKE service, its Kubernetes version upgrade policy, and cluster/node autoscaling features.
